trigger: Plays when entering the central server core where the Buffering Wheel hovers.

lines.speaker: buffering-wheel
lines.text: Buffering... 99%... Please remain motionless for eternity...

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: I KNEW IT! That spinning circle has been haunting my exports for years!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: It's firing high-latency ping spikes! Our controls are desyncing!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: CUT! Freeze the rotating blades so Sehaj can hit the core!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: I'll double your overtime if we kill this loading screen before 3 AM.
